name: clanker
description: Codex dispatcher adapter for external Opencode, Grok, and read-only Gemini Clankers over ACP.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch external coding agents without self-dispatch
interface.longDescription: Dispatch bounded read-only or isolated write tasks from Codex to external Opencode and Grok workers, plus read-only Gemini reconnaissance, through the host-aware Clanker ACP runtime.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch an external read-only review through Clanker.
